display.purpose: Wordmark and the single hero line only.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Soft offset lift on buttons/links at hover only; no resting shadows.

motion.name: ease-ink
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for entrances and state transitions.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: Slow breathing/drift of an online bot's ink current.

components.name: Primary / Invite Button
components.description: Ink-filled pill for the primary action; inverts to light-on-dark automatically in dark mode.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; background: var(--color-sumi, #141C28); color: var(--color-paper, #ECEAE3); border:none; border-radius:999px; padding:.9rem 1.8rem; font-family:'Zen Kaku Gothic New',sans-serif; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow .3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 10px 30px -12px rgba(20,28,40,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-indigo,#38597E); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Paper pill with a 1px mist border for secondary actions (Vote, GitHub, Ko-fi).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; background:transparent; color:var(--color-sumi,#141C28); border:1px solid rgba(20,28,40,0.12); border-radius:999px; padding:.9rem 1.6rem; font-family:'Zen Kaku Gothic New',sans-serif; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color .3s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); border-color:rgba(20,28,40,0.3); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-indigo,#38597E); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: State dot plus a text label; never color-only. Online dot breathes.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; font-family:'Zen Kaku Gothic New',sans-serif; font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:500; color:var(--color-ink-current,#3C4A5A); } .ds-status-dot { width:.5rem; height:.5rem; border-radius:999px; background:#81BA6C; box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(129,186,108,0.6); animation: ds-breathe 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(129,186,108,0.5)} 70%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(129,186,108,0)} }

narrative.overview: Yugen Stack is 幽玄 — subtle, profound grace — made into an interface. The surface is a still basin of sumi ink on paper-white water. Nothing is boxed; content rests in open space and is divided by hairline mist. The ground is near-monochrome ink; the only saturated color is the single bloom reserved for the bot you are looking at. Motion is the material: online ink drifts, offline ink settles gray. It is the deliberate opposite of the Discord-bot landing convention — restraint is the argument for bots that each do one thing.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-monochrome ground; accent color is rare and always earned.
Open, card-free composition organized by space and mist hairlines.
Japanese type that also sets the kanji names.
Live status expressed as motion, never as color alone.
One authored generative moment (the ink), not scattered effects.

rules.name: The One Bloom Rule
rules.body: Only one saturated color is present per region — that region's bot accent — used on ≤10% of it. Everything else is ink.

rules.name: The No-Blurple Rule
rules.body: Discord purple never appears. The Discord icon is drawn in current ink, not brand color.

rules.name: The Kanji-First Rule
rules.body: A bot's kanji is set large in Mincho beside its name as reading-contrast content, never a decorative watermark.

rules.name: The Flat-Basin Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Elevation is a response to pointer state only.

dos: Do keep the ground ink-monochrome and let exactly one bot accent bloom per region.
Do set kanji as reading-contrast content in Zen Old Mincho beside names.
Do pair every live-status color with a text label.
Do give the page one authored motion (the ink) and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do separate content with space and 1px mist, not cards.
donts: Don't use Discord blurple or any purple accent anywhere.
Don't box content in cards, nested containers, or resting drop shadows.
Don't use gradient text, tracked uppercase eyebrows, or hero-metric stat bars.
Don't let the ink obscure the wordmark, the one-liner, or any action.
Don't reintroduce Fraunces/Manrope or a centered generic-hero composition.
